title: Valor-backed $20B Series E for xAI

sources.quote: xAI completed its upsized Series E funding round, exceeding the $15 billion targeted round size, and raised $20 billion.

Investors participating in the round include Valor Equity Partners, Stepstone Group, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Qatar Investment Authority, MGX and Baron Capital Group, amongst other key partners.

explain: xAI raised $20 billion, more than its $15 billion target, from Valor, StepStone, Fidelity, Qatar Investment Authority, MGX, Baron Capital and others. No lead was named; the whole round is shown on this Valor record and each investor's own amount was not disclosed.
